content:
WT-19 (task-b1ca54f2) needs your go on the worktree default, one decision in two parts:
(a) Flip: an unset settings.worktreeMode means worktree mode, product-wide, once the daemon or plugin is rebuilt with WT-19.
(b) Gate-less projects: unset resolves to 'on' only when settings.qualityGate is non-blank. Without a gate it stays 'off', so shared mode is unchanged. Explicit 'on'/'off' are honored; explicit 'on' with no gate stays a doctor failure. A stricter option also refuses a worktree claim with no gate.
Effect: a project with a qualityGate and no worktreeMode switches at its next worker claim. Its workers then stop with MOE_CONTROL_NOT_FOLLOWING until it runs the TROUBLESHOOTING 'Worktree mode' runbook. To opt out, set worktreeMode 'off'. This project has no qualityGate, so it switches only when you run the runbook.
Approve = go on (a)+(b). To choose another (b), reject and comment on the task.
